note: People seconds per outcome for run 3 (Medplum). costs_2.json's per-outcome figures, unchanged, except where PREREGISTRATION_3.md says: B's stops are charged from the stop card's modelled seconds, and setup is split into its parts. Never changed after run 3 starts.

missed_harm.basis: As costs_2.json: USD 96 to correct one duplicate patient record, at the US median wage of a medical records specialist, USD 23.45 per hour.

caught_harm.basis: As costs_2.json (cost model V1, modelled). Arm A's charge, and B's sensitivity figure. B's primary charge is its stop card's modelled person seconds at x1 (benchmark/stop_card/PREREG_REVIEW.md).

false_stop.basis: As costs_2.json. For B, the larger of this and the stop card's modelled seconds.

correct_stop.basis: As costs_2.json. For B, the larger of this and the stop card's modelled seconds.

failed_stop.basis: As costs_2.json. For B, the larger of this and the stop card's modelled seconds.

A.basis: As costs_2.json's A: writing and checking the agent's prompt and read-back.

B.basis: The same agent setup as A; plus the person time measured while generating and reviewing B's three contracts (PERSON_LOG_3.md), filled in before the first item and frozen with the contracts; plus Medplum's one-time read-path qualification (fhir_medplum/readpath/MINUTES.md, about 35 minutes), charged in the primary figure because this run can't show it is already paid for any customer. The figure without it is reported.
